paper.abstract_en: We study statistical soliton equations on Lorentzian manifolds whose metric has generalized Robertson–Walker form and whose torsion-free affine connections are dual with respect to the metric. We first derive a trace identity for the statistical Ricci tensor and the statistical Lie derivative. Under the soliton equation, the corrected curvature-duality identity implies that the dual curvature tensor has the algebraic symmetries of metric curvature and that the two dual curvature tensors coincide. We then establish a conformal–Einstein criterion and record its algebraic consequence for a perfect-fluid-type Ricci decomposition. An explicit four-dimensional example shows that the difference tensor of the dual connections can be nonzero even when the statistical curvature vanishes.
